Matched ordinary/axis on full official train/query/gallery, no holdout. Highest normal benchmark mAP/earliest tie, all six metrics same checkpoint. Known-loss diagnostic, not a new module or proven cause/stability/+2 advantage.
anchor.limits: Common context remains auxiliary; coupled gate is not claimed calibrated. Twelve disjoint-source cases lack shared identity coordinates; missing evaluation deferred.
